Buffalo Ranch Chicken Nuggets

Juicy ground-chicken nuggets get coated in crunchy ranch protein chips, air-fried, then tossed with a bright Buffalo finish.

Prep
Not listed
Cook
Not listed
Total
30 min
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
8

Ingredients

  • 455 g (16 oz) 99/1 ground chicken
  • ¼ cup (30 g) panko breadcrumbs
  • 1 tbsp (10 g) ranch seasoning mix
  • 1 tsp each salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder
  • 2 bags (65 g total) ranch protein chips, finely crushed
  • 2 egg whites
  • ½ cup (120 ml) Buffalo hot sauce
  • Olive-oil spray

Original yield unavailable; scaling disabled.

Instructions

  1. Heat air fryer to 350°F (177°C). Mix ground chicken, panko, ranch seasoning, salt, pepper, garlic powder and onion powder.
  2. Put crushed protein chips in a shallow bowl and egg whites in a second bowl.
  3. Shape chicken mixture into bite-size nuggets. Dip each in egg whites, then coat in crushed chips. Arrange in a single layer in the air-fryer basket.
  4. Mist with olive oil and air-fry about 15 minutes, turning once, until golden and the center reaches 165°F (74°C).
  5. Brush or toss the nuggets with Buffalo sauce. Return to the air fryer for 2 minutes, then serve hot.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
